title: Excel Sheet Column Number
description: Given a string `columnTitle` representing a spreadsheet column title (where `'A'` = 1, `'B'` = 2, ..., `'Z'` = 26, `'AA'` = 27, `'AB'` = 28, ...), return its corresponding positive integer column number.
constraints: columnTitle consists only of uppercase English letters.
hints: This is bijective base-26 positional notation with digits 1..26 instead of 0..25.
Initialize result = 0, and for each character c update result = result * 26 + (ord(c) - ord('A') + 1).
